scientific_integrity: The unrestricted-parameter argument is deductive and accompanied by direct finite-model checks. General direct-base minimality is expressly credited to prior stem theory; the new assertion is the exact family-specific stem classification, enumeration and three-colour closure-lattice count.
scientific_limitations: Theorem applies to n>q>=3 with positive assignment attributes and simultaneous one-round multi-head Horn bases. No optimality is claimed among unrestricted iterative or single-head bases. Finite tests are corroborative, not all-parameter proofs. Possible equivalent results under unexamined terminology remain a priority risk.
title: Surjective-assignment closure: exact direct Horn bases and three-colour lattice counts
